snippet.description:
How can you complete your UPSC syllabus in the next 4 months while also keeping enough time for revision?

In this video, Santosh Sir explains a practical 4-month UPSC preparation strategy for covering the GS 1, GS 2, GS 3, GS 4, Essay and Optional Subject.

The strategy focuses on completing a major portion of the syllabus in the first two months and using the next two months for remaining syllabus + systematic revision.

For Optional, aim to complete around 60% of the syllabus in the first two months, while completing the remaining 40% alongside revision in the next two months.

For GS and Essay, divide the syllabus across the four months while progressively increasing the time dedicated to revision and retention.

If you are preparing for UPSC Mains 2027 and struggling to plan your syllabus completion, this video will help you create a structured 4-month study plan for UPSC Mains.

Key topics covered: UPSC syllabus completion, 4-month UPSC strategy, UPSC Mains preparation, GS 1, GS 2, GS 3, GS 4, Essay preparation, Optional preparation, revision strategy, syllabus planning and time management.
